Please read Uma's comment doc beforehand if you can (link in the chat thread from Monday), and Jamal please bring the updated timeline so we can see what Aim 3 removal does to year two milestones, and Oskar the lab cost estimates for the reduced-scope version so we compare real numbers and not guesses, and Quinn if the indirect cost rate changed again please flag it at the top so we don't build on the wrong number, thanks all, you are the best committee a chair could ask for, see you Thursday!!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0722","text":"Subject: Planning Session Required: Northpoint Site Exhibition Layout and Phasing

Dear colleagues,

I am writing to request your attendance at a two-hour working session to finalise the exhibition plan for the Northpoint site. The construction contractor requires our confirmed gallery layout and installation phasing by the end of the month, and several decisions depend on input from more than one department.

Proposed date: Wednesday 12 March, 10:00-12:00
Location: Conference Room B, Redleaf History Museum, with video link for remote colleagues

Attendees: Nico Carvalho, Beth Eriksen, Delia Nwachukwu, Fatima Hakimi, Gus Delacroix, Bea Lefebvre, and myself.

Rough agenda:
1. Gallery sequencing: Delia and Beth have proposed two competing routes, and we must choose one.
2. Conservation constraints on light and humidity for the textile collection (Fatima).
3. Loan object arrival dates versus the construction schedule (Gus).
4. Budget trade-offs between interactive displays and additional casework (Nico, Bea).

Please bring floor plans, object lists and any cost estimates you have prepared. We will work through the printed plans together and leave the room with an agreed layout.

A note on timing: I originally circulated this as 10:00 GMT, but our Northpoint colleagues are on local site time, which is one hour ahead. To be clear, the session is 10:00-12:00 London time, 11:00-13:00 at Northpoint. If the calendar invitation displays otherwise, please trust this email and let me know.

Kind regards,
Hiroshi
Head of Exhibitions"},{"spec_id":"spec_0723","text":"Fwd: Project Jasper menu & opening plan
